title: Portuguese Revista de Jogo — Cover Story Split
prompt: Create a high-fidelity desktop website UI concept mockup, wide 16:9, for Aljohn Polyglot's Portuguese language page. OPTION A — Cover Story Split. Create a completely new original art direction called Revista de Jogo: Brazilian Canarinha sports-weekly meets intimate documentary photojournalism. Preserve the site's shared white global navbar and add a slim centered yellow chapter navigation below it. Make the hero a decisive split cover: a deep-green editorial story panel on the left and one large verified real event photograph on the right, with a smaller overlapping verified event photograph near the fold. The hero must use event photography from Aljohn's real events in the Philippines, never a YouTube thumbnail. Portuguese headline: MEU PORTUGUÊS ACONTECEU ENTRE PESSOAS. Supporting line: Do futebol às conversas que encontrei nas Filipinas. Actions: VER MINHAS CONVERSAS and CONHECER AS VOZES. Begin the next fold with a warm-paper editorial index for Minha história, Entrevistas, Cultura & jogo, and Bastidores. Use deep Brazil green, Canarinha yellow, cobalt blue, warm paper white, and near-black ink. Pair a condensed editorial display face with a readable sans-serif. Preserve real people and documentary character; crop carefully without distortion. Avoid generic UI cards, bento grids, dashboards, scoreboards, pitch graphics, statistics, sticker piles, gradients, glassmorphism, Italian styling, stretched imagery, oversized empty titles, and YouTube imagery in the hero. Render the whole browser viewport as a polished production-realistic frontend comp with legible Portuguese copy.
